title: Model picker tool dispatch
responsibility: Validates picker tool arguments and routes catalog, status, switch and cancellation operations to the provider-switch service.

inputs.name: pickerMcpTools.service
inputs.description: Provider-switch service exposing catalog, observed sessions, status, request and cancellation operations.

inputs.name: pickerMcpTools.name
inputs.description: Operation name: list_models, list_observed_sessions, request_model_switch, cancel_model_switch, open_model_picker or get_provider_status.

inputs.name: pickerMcpTools.input
inputs.description: Operation arguments, validated against the applicable strict schema for status, switch or cancel. List operations ignore input.

outputs.name: pickerSessionSchema
outputs.description: Strict object schema with an optional string session_id.

outputs.name: pickerSwitchSchema
outputs.description: Strict schema requiring session_id, provider openai or harness-claude, model and effort strings.

outputs.name: pickerCancelSchema
outputs.description: Strict schema requiring session_id and request_id strings.

outputs.name: pickerMcpTools
outputs.description: Promise of the service result: model/session lists, switch request, cancellation or status. Missing session for status becomes null; this dispatcher does not itself launch a UI.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown for an unknown operation; schema parse and service failures may also reject.
